content.title: How Much Does Rory McIlroy Make? Inside the Pro Golfer’s Net Worth and Earnings On and Off the Course
content.text: With multiple championship wins under his belt, Rory McIlroy has become one of the greatest — and wealthiest — players in the professional golf world. Since beginning his professional career in 2007, the Irish golf star has become a dominant force both on and off the course. A three-time FedEx Cup winner and 29-time PGA Tour champ, McIlroy has had many opportunities to add to both his golf legacy and his growing fortune. On April 13, his career reached new heights when his 2025 Masters Tournament win led him to achieve one of golf's most prestigious honors: the Career Grand Slam. Per the PGA tour, the honor of successfully claiming all four of the major golf championships has been 11 years in the making for McIlroy. "It feels incredible," McIlroy told CBS following his Masters win. "This is my 17th time here, and I started to wonder if it would ever be my time. The last 10 years coming here with the burden of the Grand Slam on my shoulders and trying to achieve that ... I’m honored and thrilled and so proud to call myself a Masters champion." Although his exact net worth is unknown, according to Forbes, he was expected to have earned $83 million during the 2024 league year alone between his golf earnings and endorsements. He has also earned spots on the outlet's list of the top 50 highest-paid athletes worldwide and the 10 highest-paid golfers worldwide. So, what has Rory McIlroy made both on the golf course and off? From his career earnings to his business ventures, here's everything to know about the golf star's worth. What is Rory McIlroy’s net worth? Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland is awarded the Green Jacket by Masters Champion Scottie Scheffler after the final round of the 2025 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club on April 13, 2025, in Augusta, Ga. Richard Heathcote/Getty While McIlroy's exact current net worth is unknown, Forbes has shared insight into the golf star's earnings in recent years. In June 2024, the outlet reported that McIlroy was expected to have earned $83 million for the year. Forbes attributed golf as McIlroy's main source of wealth, with $38 million coming from his salary and winnings and an additional $45 million in endorsements. Additionally, in 2024, McIlroy was named to Forbes' list of the top 50 highest-paid athletes worldwide and made the list of the 10 highest-paid golf players that year. How much has Rory McIlroy made from golf? Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland plays his shot from the second tee during the final round of THE PLAYERS Championship on the Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass on March 16, 2025, in Ponte Vedra Beach, Fla. Jared C. Tilton/Getty McIlroy's professional golf career has been marked by numerous wins, which all result in a large portion of the prize purse. According to the PGA Tour, McIlroy has made over $104.25 million in career earnings. Most recently, McIlroy earned $4.2 million of the 2025 Masters prize purse. Despite it being the largest earning in Masters history, it wasn't McIlroy's biggest payday of 2025. After winning The Players Championship in March, the golf star earned $4.5 million, per USA Today. One of his largest prizes came in 2022, when he won $18 million for claiming the FedEx Cup title, contributing to the $26.7 million in prize money he earned that year, per Forbes. What businesses does Rory McIlroy own? Rory McIlroy of Team Europe looks on ahead of walking on stage during the opening ceremony for the 2023 Ryder Cup at Marco Simone Golf Club on Sept. 28, 2023, in Rome. Luke Walker/Getty In addition to a successful golf career, McIlroy has also built a business empire. According to Forbes, he has earned the second-most amount from off the course earnings, just behind golf legend Tiger Woods. In 2019, McIlroy and his business manager Sean O'Flaherty created Symphony Ventures, a firm focused on investing in the healthcare, sports and technology sectors. According to Forbes, the firm has invested in companies such as Puttery, Hyperice and Whoop. A few years later, he teamed up with Woods for another big business venture. In 2022, the pro golf stars announced that they had founded TMRW Sports, a tech-focused venture that launched indoor golf league TGL. What are Rory McIlroy's biggest endorsement deals and partnerships? Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland looks on while warming up on the practice range prior to the playoff during the final round of The Players Championship on the Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass on March 17, 2025, in Ponte Vedra Beach, Fla. Richard Heathcote/Getty McIlroy has been expanding his brand off the golf course for years, securing a wide range of endorsements and partnerships. In 2024, Forbes reported that the athlete had earned an estimated $45 million in endorsements, from sponsors including Workday, Nike, Omega, Optum and TaylorMade. As for partnerships, McIlroy teamed up with NBC Sports in 2019 to launch GolfPass, a digital subscription service aimed at helping golfers improve their game, per Forbes. How much has Rory McIlroy donated to charity? Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland celebrates with the trophy after winning the playoff in the final round of The Players Championship on the Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass on March 17, 2025, in Ponte Vedra Beach, Fla. Richard Heathcote/Getty In 2013, McIlroy launched his official charity organization, The Rory Foundation, which led a number of initiatives aimed at supporting the youth. Although the foundation ceased operations in 2018, per the Belfast Telegraph, McIlroy has donated a portion of his career earnings to charity over the years.
